<style></style><header id="fancy-header" class="fancy-header breadcrumbs-mobile-off content-left" >
    <div class="wf-wrap"><div class="fancy-title-head hgroup"><h1 class="fancy-title entry-title" ><span>Kiteboarding  Lessons</span></h1></div><div class="assistive-text">You are here:</div><ol class="breadcrumbs text-small" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/BreadcrumbList"><li itemprop="itemListElement" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/ListItem"><a itemprop="item" href="https://bluedreamhotel.com/" title="Home"><span itemprop="name">Home</span></a><meta itemprop="position" content="1" /></li><li itemprop="itemListElement" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/ListItem"><a itemprop="item" href="https://bluedreamhotel.com/kitesurfingcostarica/" title="Kite Surfing in CR"><span itemprop="name">Kite Surfing in CR</span></a><meta itemprop="position" content="2" /></li><li class="current" itemprop="itemListElement" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/ListItem"><span itemprop="name">Kiteboarding Lessons</span><meta itemprop="position" content="3" /></li></ol></div>

<div id="main" class="sidebar-none sidebar-divider-vertical">
	<div class="main-gradient"></div>
	<div class="wf-wrap">
	<div class="wf-container-main">
	<div id="content" class="content" role="main">
		<div class="wpb-content-wrapper" id="wpb-content-root"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<div style="text-align: center;">
<div style="text-align: center;"></div>
<div style="text-align: center;"></div>
<div style="text-align: center;">FOR LESSONS INFOS WRITE TO THE WHATSAPP +(506)88265221 with Nicola</div>
</div>
<div style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>PLEASE RESERVE KITE AND WING LESSONS IN ADVANCE</strong></span></div>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: justify;"><strong><strong>BLUE DREAM </strong>KITESURFING SCHOOL</strong> is the first kiteboarding school in Central America, born in 2000, providing all the services a kiter deserve: We are open between the beginning of November and the end of July. In these last 27 years of teaching experience, we made happy more then 5000 students world wide. Our mission is to create kiteboarders with certified instructors following international safety standards. We provide lessons in English, Spanish, French and Italian.</p>
<h4><strong>Private Lessons:</strong></h4>
		</div>
	</div>
</div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-8"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1631317609138"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_message_box vc_message_box-standard vc_message_box-rounded vc_color-grey" ><div class="vc_message_box-icon"><i class="fas fa-graduation-cap"></i></div><p><span style="text-align: justify;"><strong>1st lesson (land lesson): C</strong>ontrol of a small inflatable kite with shorter lines close to the water. First body dragging in the water with instructor and alone. Understanding and practicing the kite  water relaunch, simulation of water start without the board: 3 hours </span></p>
</div><div class="vc_message_box vc_message_box-standard vc_message_box-rounded vc_color-grey" ><div class="vc_message_box-icon"><i class="fas fa-graduation-cap"></i></div><p><strong>2nd lesson (body dragging and first water starts): </strong>Body dragging with the instructor and alone with bigger kite and longer lines, kite water launch, approach to the board, demo of the water start by the instructor, first water starts with the instructor: 3 hours.</p>
</div><div class="vc_message_box vc_message_box-standard vc_message_box-rounded vc_color-grey" ><div class="vc_message_box-icon"><i class="fas fa-graduation-cap"></i></div><p><strong>3rd lesson (water start and riding): </strong>water start alone with bigger kite, first rides with the board in both directions, self rescue technique. 3 hours</p>

	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><a class="dt-pswp-item" href="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_2927-scaled.jpeg" data-dt-img-description="" data-large_image_width="1920" data-large_image_height="2560"><img decoding="async" class="alignnone size-medium wp-image-2452" src="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_2927-225x300.jpeg" alt="" width="225" height="300" srcset="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_2927-225x300.jpeg 225w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_2927-768x1024.jpeg 768w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_2927-1152x1536.jpeg 1152w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_2927-1536x2048.jpeg 1536w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_2927-scaled.jpeg 1920w" sizes="(max-width: 225px) 100vw, 225px" /></a></p>
<p>We recommend that students learning this sport be in good physical condition and feel comfortable in the water.</p>
<p><strong>KITEBOARDING LESSON</strong> INCLUDE GEAR AND ARE PROVIDED BY IKO CERTIFIED INSTRUCTORS (Look who we are in <strong>ABOUT US</strong>) WITH A LOT OF EXPERIENCE. Lessons are usually in English but we can teach in Spanish, French and Italian under request.</p>
<p><strong><em>GROUP LESSONS:</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li style="text-align: justify;">Beginner lessons in group of 2 or 3 people of the same level:</li>
<li style="text-align: justify;">$60 per hour per person.</li>
<li style="text-align: justify;">3 hours package is $150 per person</li>
<li style="text-align: justify;">9 hours package is $405 per person</li>
</ul>
<p><em><strong>PRIVATE LESSONS:</strong></em></p>
<ul>
<li> private lessons: $80 per hour.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>3 hours is $210 for 3 hours package.</li>
<li>9 hours is $595 for 9 hours package</li>
</ul>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center">
		<h2 class="wpb_heading wpb_singleimage_heading">Our instructors can take a video and record the voice of the student. It is easier to review your lessons after you finish it. Amazing results when you are training with recorded video while your instructor gives the real time feedback. This additional service is $30 per session and include recording and editing</h2>
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper  "><img decoding="async" width="300" height="255" src="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Captura-de-Pantalla-2023-09-08-a-las-18.52.01-300x255.png" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-medium" alt="" title="Captura de Pantalla 2023-09-08 a la(s) 18.52.01" srcset="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Captura-de-Pantalla-2023-09-08-a-las-18.52.01-300x255.png 300w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Captura-de-Pantalla-2023-09-08-a-las-18.52.01.png 370w" sizes="(max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px"  data-dt-location="https://bluedreamhotel.com/kitesurfingcostarica/lessons/captura-de-pantalla-2023-09-08-a-las-18-52-01/" /></div>
		</figure>

	<div  class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_center">
		<h2 class="wpb_heading wpb_singleimage_heading">Once the student is ready to practice alone in the water we use the Bb talking radio communication for a safer and faster way of learning</h2>
		<figure class="wpb_wrapper vc_figure">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper  "><img decoding="async" width="300" height="200" src="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/bbtalking-radio-communication-300x200.jpeg" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-medium" alt="" title="bbtalking radio communication to learn in the safest and fast way" srcset="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/bbtalking-radio-communication-300x200.jpeg 300w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/bbtalking-radio-communication-768x512.jpeg 768w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/bbtalking-radio-communication.jpeg 1000w" sizes="(max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px"  data-dt-location="https://bluedreamhotel.com/kitesurfingcostarica/lessons/bbtalking-radio-communication/" /></div>
		</figure>
	</div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="standard-arrow list-divider bullet-top"><p><a class="dt-pswp-item" href="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_3024-scaled.jpeg" data-dt-img-description="" data-large_image_width="2560" data-large_image_height="1920"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="alignnone size-medium wp-image-2454" src="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_3024-300x225.jpeg" alt="" width="300" height="225" srcset="https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_3024-300x225.jpeg 300w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_3024-1024x768.jpeg 1024w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_3024-768x576.jpeg 768w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_3024-1536x1152.jpeg 1536w, https://bluedreamhotel.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/IMG_3024-2048x1536.jpeg 2048w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px" /></a></p>
<p><strong>Students SHOULD NEED to bring the following:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>water shoes (booties) to walk comfortably in and out the water and protect your feet from shells or little stones,</li>
<li>sun glasses with bungee</li>
<li>short wetsuit just in January, February and March (during these months water can be cooler due to the strong winds)</li>
<li>hat with bungee</li>
<li>high protection water proof sun block</li>
<li>long sleeve lycra</li>
</ul>
<p>We have these items for sale in our Resort but we might don’t have all the sizes of the water shoes</p>
</div></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid dt-default" style="margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><iframe loading="lazy" style="border: 0;" src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m14!1m8!1m3!1d15664.567507877018!2d-85.708809!3d11.0279803!3m2!1i1024!2i768!4f13.1!3m3!1m2!1s0x8f75a3e3de3477a9%3A0x642a3fafd3789899!2sBlue%20Dream%20kiteboarding%20school%20Costa%20Rica!5e0!3m2!1ses-419!2scr!4v1694217760084!5m2!1ses-419!2scr" width="100%" height="450" allowfullscreen="allowfullscreen"></iframe></p>
		</div>
	</div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p><strong>PACKAGES are considered only by doing 3h consecutively and they have to be paid up front before 8:45AM at front desk. Package lessons start at 9:30 am or 1pm</strong></p>
<p>The instructors will help students set realistic goals and achieve them depending on the level, using radio helmet communication when needed.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;">The usual amount of hours to achieve an absolute beginner course and be independent it is 9/12 hours, divided in 3/4 days.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>These prices are by cash only</strong>. PayPal payments get an overcharge of 6%, credit card 17%.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>Equipment used for lessons and rentals:</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="color: #000000;">We care our guests! Safety first. We provide 3 of the best brands in the market as DUOTONE, CORE, SLINGSHOT, ION and RIDE ENGINE. Our kite</span> school also supply the following equipment during courses and rentals, maximum 2 year old: directional, twin tip &amp; foil boards<span style="color: #ff4013;"> </span>– life jackets – harness – helmets.</p>
<p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>KITE GEAR RENTAL (from 9:30 am &#8217;til 4 pm)</strong>: For those kiters that don’t need lessons and they can STAY UPWIND and make transitions, we provide it:</p>
<p><strong>Full gear</strong> is $95 per day or $65 up to 1 hour.</p>
<p>or $65 for the kite &amp; bar, $30 for the board, $8 for the harness (eventually we also rent water shoes, life jacket and helmet for $6 each one)</p>
<p>3 day rental package is $270</p>
<p>6 days rental packages is $480</p>
<p><strong>Assistant</strong> for beginners is $10 per hour (2h minimum) if the student sporadically isn&#8217;t able to ride back at the starting point (if the student just finished the absolute beginner course, he/she should take more lessons before renting).</p>
		</div>
